name: 12 Kitchen and Wine
where: Berawa / Pantai Berawa
why_its_here: An all-day restaurant and wine bar on Jalan Pantai Berawa, open 8am to midnight every day. Its own site describes cooking done on the grill using local ingredients, alongside breakfast service and a large wine list. Booking is offered through the website or WhatsApp but is not required.
best_for: A date or unhurried dinner over wine; open 8am to midnight, seven days

name: 2 aces massage and spa
why_its_here: Massage studio in Seminyak. The published list covers Traditional Massage.
best_for: Traditional massage booked the same day.

name: Acala Bar & Bistro
where: Bali Collection Blok B1 No.2, Benoa, Kec. Kuta Sel., Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361
why_its_here: Restaurant in Nusa Dua, open daily 10:30am-10:00pm.

name: Afterglow Bar and Kitchen at Tribe Bali Kuta Beach
where: Jl. Pantai Kuta No.99, Legian, Kec. Kuta, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361
why_its_here: Afterglow Bar and Kitchen is the rooftop restaurant at TRIBE Bali Kuta Beach. It overlooks Kuta's shoreline, and the rooftop also includes an infinity pool. The venue opens daily from 07:00 to 23:00.
best_for: Rooftop drinks or dinner with views across Kuta Beach.
not_for: Diners who prefer to avoid rooftop and beach-strip settings.

name: Air Terjun Gitgit
why_its_here: A multi-tier waterfall on the mountain road between south Bali and Singaraja, Buleleng, one of north Bali's most visited falls.
best_for: a waterfall stop on the drive to/from north Bali

name: Akasa at Jumeirah Bali
where: Raya Uluwatu Street, Pecatu, Kec. Kuta Sel., Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361
why_its_here: Restaurant on Raya Uluwatu Street in Uluwatu Bukit, open daily 12:00-11:00pm.

name: Alchemy Yoga & Meditation Center Uluwatu
why_its_here: Yoga and meditation centre on Jl. Pantai Bingin. Class passes run five classes over fourteen days or ten over a month, with a separate rate for KITAS holders and residents.
best_for: A yoga habit while staying in Bingin

name: Alila Seminyak Yoga
why_its_here: The yoga and movement programme at Alila Seminyak on the Petitenget beachfront. Morning yoga and mat pilates run as resort activities, and Spa Alila adds meditation and recovery classes. The property has a gym and a separate Movement Studio used for classes.
best_for: Beachfront Seminyak guests who want a morning class and mat pilates without booking into a studio elsewhere.

name: Aliya Salon and Day Spa
why_its_here: Day spa in Canggu. The published list covers Traditional Massage and Reflexology. The Aliya Full Body Massage is 195K IDR for 60 minutes. Booking runs through Fresha.
best_for: Tired feet after a day of walking.

name: Alma Tapas Bar at Canggu
where: Jl. Pantai Berawa, Canggu, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361
why_its_here: A Spanish tapas bar on Jalan Pantai Berawa serving from 3pm daily, with food until 10.30pm and drinks until 11.30pm. The February 2026 menu runs from jamon and charcuterie through plancha seafood to beef cheeks and tartares, alongside separate wine and bar lists. A second Alma operates at Pantai Bingin in Uluwatu.
best_for: Shared plates and wine over a long evening; small groups grazing from 3pm
not_for: Opens at 3pm - no breakfast or lunch at the Berawa site

name: Amandari
why_its_here: Wellness spa in Ubud. The published list covers Balinese Massage. Booking is on the venue's own site.
best_for: A long reset — treatments run up to 120 minutes.

name: Amplitude Skate & Bike Park
why_its_here: A 3000 square metre concrete skatepark in Kerobokan, split between a street course and a bowl park with three bowls, the largest an Olympic-size 10ft. Its own site welcomes skateboards, kickboards, cruisers and inline skates. The on-site school runs 1.5-hour group and private lessons from age four, with boards included in the price.
best_for: Learning to skate from age 4, or a session in a 3000m2 bowl and street park
not_for: Lessons by prior booking and non-refundable; minimum age 4

name: Anandinii
why_its_here: Massage studio in Sidemen. The published list covers Balinese Massage. Balinese Massage 60 minutes is 300K IDR for 60 minutes. Booking is on the venue's own site.
best_for: A long reset — treatments run up to 150 minutes.

name: Anantara Ubud Bali Resort
why_its_here: Day spa in Ubud. The published list covers Thai Massage. Thai Warrior Stretching Massage is 2850K IDR for 60 minutes. Booking is on the venue's own site.
best_for: Thai massage booked the same day.
not_for: A budget massage — the list starts at 2850K IDR.

name: Ankhusa Restaurant Ubud by Wonderspace
where: Jl. Raya Desa Kenderan No.88 A, Kenderan, Kecamatan Ubud, Kabupaten Gianyar, Bali 80571, Indonesia
why_its_here: Restaurant at Aksari Resort in Kenderan, north of Ubud. Balinese, Indonesian and international dishes: roast duck, chicken satay, nasi goreng, oxtail. Royal Dining follows the Balinese megibung tradition and is served as a shared feast. Outdoor tables face the jungle.
best_for: A shared Balinese feast with a group

name: Ants Pants Uluwatu
where: Family Nest Experience Villas, JI. Labuansait, JI Jl. Pantai Cemongkak, Pecatu, Kec. Kuta Sel., Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361, Indonesia
why_its_here: Restaurant and pool at Family Nest Villas near Bingin. Contemporary Australian cooking, breakfast all day and pizza from midday. The ground floor is open-air; upstairs is an air-conditioned coworking room. Poolside cabanas and sunbeds are held with a deposit that comes off the bill.
best_for: A work morning that ends by the pool
not_for: Dinner - the kitchen stops at 19:00

name: Apéritif Restaurant
where: Br. Nagi, Jl. Lanyahan, Petulu, Kecamatan Ubud, Kabupaten Gianyar, Bali 80571, Indonesia
why_its_here: Apéritif Restaurant is a degustation restaurant in Petulu combining French, Japanese and Indonesian influences.
best_for: Travellers planning a formal tasting-menu meal near Ubud.

name: ARCTIC Restaurant – Breakfast, Brunch & Dinner
where: Sriwedari street, Ubud, Kecamatan Ubud, Kabupaten Gianyar, Bali 80571
why_its_here: Restaurant in Sriwedari street, Ubud.

name: Artisan - Ungasan
where: Uluwatu St, Ungasan, South Kuta, Badung Regency, Bali 80361
why_its_here: Restaurant on Uluwatu St in Uluwatu Bukit, open daily 7:30am-10:30pm.

name: AVLI
where: Pecatu, South Kuta, Badung Regency, Bali 80361, Indonesia
why_its_here: AVLI is a modern Greek restaurant in Pecatu with an open-air courtyard. AVLI serves sharing plates with pita, dips, grilled meats and seasonal seafood. Greek chef Angelos Lantos leads the kitchen.
best_for: Dinner with shared plates; courtyard celebrations and private dining.
not_for: Lunch plans - AVLI publishes a 5 pm opening time.

name: Ayam Betutu Khas Gilimanuk
where: Jl. Merdeka No. 88, Renon, Denpasar Timur, Kota Denpasar, Bali 80235
why_its_here: A long-running Denpasar specialist in ayam betutu, the Gilimanuk-style chicken slow-cooked in Balinese spice paste until it falls off the bone. It is a focused, no-frills local kitchen where the betutu and the sambals are the whole point.
best_for: trying a genuine balinese classic; a spice-forward local lunch; eating where residents eat away from the tourist strip
not_for: people avoiding chilli or wanting mild flavours; anyone after a western menu, cocktails or a scenic view

name: AYANA Bali Yoga
why_its_here: The yoga programme on the AYANA estate in Jimbaran, run from the resort's aerobics and yoga studio. Classes are open to guests across the estate's shared facilities, and aerial yoga is part of the schedule alongside standard mat classes.
best_for: Estate guests who want scheduled classes without leaving the grounds, including aerial yoga.

name: Baan Ying Thai
where: Uluwatu St No.88, Ungasan, South Kuta, Badung Regency, Bali 80361
why_its_here: Restaurant in Uluwatu Bukit, open daily 10:00am-11:00pm.

name: Baas Terrace and Wine Locked Lounge at Metland Venya Ubud
where: Kelabang Moding, Tegallalang, Kecamatan Ubud, Kabupaten Gianyar, Bali 80561
why_its_here: Restaurant in Kelabang Moding, Ubud.

name: Babi Guling Sari Kembar 99
why_its_here: A babi guling warung in Canggu trading under the Sari Kembar 99 name, which appears on several outlets around Badung and Denpasar. Babi guling is Balinese spit-roast pork, usually served over rice with sides.
best_for: Babi guling in Canggu; one of several outlets trading as Sari Kembar 99

name: Warung Babi Guling Swari
why_its_here: Warung Babi Guling Swari serves Balinese roast pork with crispy skin and bumbu genep. Its official link hub lists a Canggu branch and ordering through GrabFood, GoFood and ShopeeFood.
best_for: Pork eaters planning a straightforward babi guling stop in Canggu.
not_for: Vegetarian, halal or otherwise pork-free dining plans.

name: Bahari Balinese Spa - 芭荷蕊巴里岛Spa精油按摩养生馆
why_its_here: Day spa in Nusa Dua. The published list covers Head Massage. Head To Toes is 350K IDR for 90 minutes. Booking is on the venue's own site.
best_for: Head massage booked the same day.

name: Bali Beach Hotel Fitness Centre
why_its_here: A new 24-hour fitness centre at Bali Beach Hotel in north Sanur, free but restricted to hotel guests. The room is large and well equipped. It sits on a property built around a 57 by 37 metre beachfront pool facing the Indian Ocean.
best_for: Guests of the hotel who want a modern round-the-clock gym; day visitors are not admitted.

name: Bali Beach Hotel Yoga / Wellness
why_its_here: Sunrise yoga at 06:00 at Bali Beach Hotel in north Sanur, alongside the Taru Pramana Spa & Wellness, open 09:00-21:00. The hotel's main pool measures 57 by 37 metres and faces Sanur Beach.
best_for: Early risers staying in north Sanur who want a 6am beachfront class before the heat.

name: Bali Padel Academy
why_its_here: A padel centre on Jalan Babakan Kubu in Canggu, open 7am to 11pm daily except Nyepi, with court time booked through the Playtomic app. It runs one-hour coached lessons alongside open court hire, and has a recovery area with a sauna and ice bath. Its own site describes it as the international headquarters of the NOX Future Academy.
best_for: Booked padel courts, hour-long coached lessons, sauna and ice-bath recovery.
not_for: Courts book through the Playtomic app; 50% fee to cancel inside 24h.

name: Bali Reflexology
why_its_here: Wellness spa in Tabanan. The published list covers Balinese Massage. Booking is on the venue's own site.
best_for: Balinese massage booked the same day.

name: Bali Tropic Resort
why_its_here: Wellness spa in Nusa Dua. The published list covers Traditional Massage. Warm Herbal Pouch Massage is 618K IDR for 60 minutes.
best_for: Traditional massage booked the same day.
not_for: A budget massage — the list starts at 618K IDR.

name: Bali Yoga School
why_its_here: Wellness spa in Ubud. The published list covers Ayurvedic Treatment. Booking is on the venue's own site.
best_for: Ayurvedic treatment booked the same day.

name: Balumba Surf School
why_its_here: A surf school running lessons around Uluwatu's breaks -- Dreamland, Padang Padang and Balangan.
best_for: surf lessons across the Bukit's beaches

name: Bambou Café & Lagree Cemagi
where: Cemagi / Mengwi / Cemagi / Mengening
why_its_here: A cafe on Jl. Pantai Mengening in Cemagi serving coffee, brunch and dinner, with a Lagree reformer studio on the same site. Its own Instagram bills the venue as Coffee & Lagree, while the studio itself trades as Kysko Studio Bali and takes class bookings through ClassPass. The cafe lists a phone number for bookings and also takes walk-ins.
best_for: Coffee and a sit-down brunch or dinner in Cemagi, with a Lagree studio on site.

name: Bambu Pilates
why_its_here: Pilates by Bambu on Jl. Pantai Bingin, part of Bambu Fitness. Reformer classes stay small, with certified instructors working on control, alignment and movement efficiency. Group strength and conditioning classes run in the same gym. Drop-ins are welcome.
best_for: Reformer and strength training at one address

name: Barbacoa
where: Jl. Petitenget No.14, Kerobokan Kelod, Kuta Utara, Badung, Bali 80361, Indonesia
why_its_here: Barbacoa Bali is a Latin American restaurant in Petitenget built around live-fire cooking and sharing plates.
best_for: Groups and couples choosing a live-fire dinner near Seminyak.

name: Bebek Tepi Sawah
where: Banjar Teges, Jl. Raya Teges, Peliatan, Ubud, Gianyar 80571
why_its_here: A rice-field restaurant built around crispy duck and traditional Balinese setting.
best_for: Family-friendly Balinese dining with a scenic setting.
not_for: People wanting a quick central-Ubud walk-in meal.

name: Begawan Biji Restaurant Ubud (Organic Farm-To-Table)
where: Melinggih Kelod, Payangan, Gianyar Regency, Bali 80572
why_its_here: Restaurant in Melinggih Kelod, Ubud, open daily 11:30am-10:00pm.

name: Bell'Aria (SereS Springs Resort and Spa Ubud)
where: SereS Springs Resort and Spa Jalan Jukut Paku, Singakerta, Ubud, Bali 80571
why_its_here: Restaurant in SereS Springs Resort and Spa Jalan Jukut Paku, Ubud.

name: Bella by Sage
where: Jl. Penestanan, Sayan, Ubud, Gianyar 80571
why_its_here: A vegan plant-based kitchen in Penestanan with pizzas, pastas, salads and gluten-free accommodation.
best_for: Vegan, gluten-free and casual Italian-style dining.
not_for: People wanting a traditional local warung or fine dining tasting menu.

name: Bella
why_its_here: Restaurant in Canggu. The kitchen is described as contemporary Mediterranean & Middle Eastern. The published menu includes ‘It was all a dream’, ‘Geisha’ and ‘Kopi Martini’. Booking is on the venue's own site.
best_for: Contemporary Mediterranean & Middle Eastern in Canggu.

name: Bella Italia Sanur
where: Sanur
why_its_here: Italian restaurant on Jalan Cemara (Sanur Kauh) serving wood-fired pizza, homemade pasta and Italian desserts, with vegetarian options.
best_for: families and groups wanting familiar Italian food; casual dinners and pizza nights
not_for: anyone specifically seeking Indonesian or Balinese cuisine

name: Bistro Anwa
where: Jl. Umalas Tunon No.23A, Kerobokan Kelod, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361, Indonesia
why_its_here: Western bistro on the ground floor of Anwa Bali in Umalas. Organic and fresh ingredients, from all-day brunch to pizza and pasta. Resident chef Josh came from Byron Bay. A rooftop bar and a spa sit upstairs.
best_for: Brunch that runs into a spa afternoon

name: BKeto Bali at Blue Karma Dijiwa Seminyak
where: Gg. Bima No.2, Seminyak, Kec. Kuta, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361
why_its_here: Restaurant on Gg. Bima No.2 in Seminyak, open daily 7:30am-11:00pm.

name: Boheme Restaurant at Shore Amora Canggu
where: Jl. Pantai Pererenan No.159, Pererenan, Kec. Mengwi, Kabupaten Badung, Bali
why_its_here: The all-day restaurant and bar inside Shore Amora Canggu on Jl. Pantai Pererenan No.159, open 7am-10pm daily to hotel and day guests alike. The kitchen serves Western food built on local, seasonal produce, with vegan, gluten-free and lactose-free options. An infinity pool with daybeds and an air-conditioned coworking space open until 10pm sit alongside it.
best_for: A slow brunch, a laptop-and-coffee day by the pool, and easy all-day eating.
not_for: Closes 10pm; rice-field views rather than beachfront, and not a nightlife spot.

name: Bokashi Bali at Berawa
where: Jl. Subak Sari No.2, Canggu, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361
why_its_here: A cafe and teahouse upstairs above the Bokashi organic grocery store on Jl. Subak Sari in Berawa, seating about 30. The menu is Japanese-leaning brunch, bento, soba and donburi alongside single-origin Indonesian teas and matcha. The group's Pererenan branch is closed until further notice.
best_for: A calm daytime meal, matcha and tea, and health-conscious Japanese plates.
not_for: Closes early evening; a small upstairs room of about 30 seats.

name: Boneka Restaurant at The St. Regis Bali Resort
where: Kawasan Pariwisata Nusa Dua Lot S6, St. Regis, Lt.Lobby, Benoa, South Kuta, Badung Regency, Bali 80363
why_its_here: Restaurant in Kawasan Pariwisata Nusa Dua Lot S6, Nusa Dua.

name: Botanist Restaurant Ubud at Blue Karma Dijiwa Ubud
where: Kelabang Moding, Banjar Bentuyung, Ubud, Kec. Tegallalang, Kabupaten Gianyar, Bali 80571
why_its_here: Restaurant in Kelabang Moding, Ubud, open daily 8:00am-11:00pm.

name: Brie Restaurant & Cheesery
where: Jl. Penestanan Kelod, Sayan, Kecamatan Ubud, Kabupaten Gianyar, Bali 80571, Indonesia
why_its_here: The only restaurant in Bali with its own cheesery. Milk comes from the group's farm in Java and becomes cheese within twelve hours, five times a week. Cheese board, truffle tagliatelle, brie burger and house burrata. The open kitchen is downstairs, the bar above.
best_for: Anyone who came to Bali and misses cheese

name: Bukit Cinta Restaurant and Bar at The Lokha Ubud
where: Br. Bangkiangsidem, Keliki, Kecamatan Ubud, Kabupaten Gianyar, Bali 80571
why_its_here: Restaurant in Br. Bangkiangsidem, Ubud, open daily 7:00am-10:00pm.

name: Bunut Bolong
why_its_here: A natural tunnel formed by a giant banyan tree that the coastal road passes straight through, in Manggis Sari village, Pekutatan district, Jembrana.
best_for: a quick photo stop on the Denpasar-Gilimanuk route through West Bali

name: Cabana Lounge at Alila Ubud
where: Inside Alila Ubud, Melinggih Kelod, Kec. Payangan, Kabupaten Gianyar, Bali 80572
why_its_here: Restaurant in Inside Alila Ubud, Ubud, open daily 10:00am-10:00pm.

name: Caffè Torino by Venticinque Group at Grand Srikandi Mansion
where: Jl. Cepaka Utama No.32, Dalung, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80351
why_its_here: An Italian cafe and restaurant from the Venticinque Group, set inside Grand Srikandi Mansion on Jl. Cepaka Utama in Dalung, inland from the Canggu coast. Its Chope listing describes rice-field views and an all-day menu running from breakfast panini through cured-meat boards to pasta.
best_for: Italian coffee, cake and pasta over rice-field views at Grand Srikandi Mansion

name: Cantina Classe — Canggu
where: Jl. Canggu Padang Linjong No.8C, Canggu, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361, Indonesia
why_its_here: Italian restaurant on Jl. Canggu Padang Linjong, part of the Wonderspace group. Handmade pizza and fresh pasta. Fettuccine truffle carbonara and a four-cheese pizza are on the menu.
best_for: Pizza and pasta after a day at Batu Bolong

name: Cantina Classe — Ubud
where: Jl. Drupadi, Melinggih, Kec. Payangan, Kabupaten Gianyar, Bali 80572, Indonesia
why_its_here: Italian restaurant in Payangan, north-west of Ubud, part of the Wonderspace group. Handmade pizza and pasta, including fettuccine truffle carbonara and a four-cheese pizza.
best_for: Italian food on the road through Payangan

name: Casa de Lokha Mexican Grill and Fusion (The Lokha Ubud)
where: The Lokha Ubud, Jalan Bangkiang Sidem No.250, Ubud, Bali 80561
why_its_here: Casa de Lokha is The Lokha Ubud's Mexican grill and fusion restaurant in Keliki. Its current offer pairs Tacos Tuesday with a separate two-for-one cocktail programme at the resort.
best_for: Small groups planning tacos and cocktails at a Ubud resort.
not_for: Diners seeking a strictly traditional Mexican-only menu.

name: Celebrity Fitness
why_its_here: The first international gym chain to open in Bali, at Lippo Plaza on Sunset Road. A full floor with a cycling studio, pilates, free weights and cardio, plus personal training and group classes. Membership tiers run from a single club to access across the chain abroad.
best_for: A membership that works in other cities too

name: Celestine Spa
why_its_here: Spa in Legian. Booking is by WhatsApp.
best_for: A long reset — treatments run up to 120 minutes.
not_for: A budget massage — the list starts at 1300K IDR.

name: Cemara Point by Dusun Bedugul Asri
where: Candikuning, Baturiti, Tabanan Regency, Bali 82191, Indonesia
why_its_here: Bar at Dusun Bedugul Asri in Candikuning. It stands between a koi pond and a vineyard, inside a flower garden. Wine, tea and light snacks, with workshops on the schedule. Dapur Cemara is the resort's main restaurant.
best_for: A glass of wine in the Bedugul cool

name: Chamas Brazilian Churrascaria at Kuta
where: Jl. Setia Budi, Kuta, Kec. Kuta, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361
why_its_here: Chamas is a Brazilian churrascaria inside Bali Bites Complex in Kuta. Passadores serve open-flame meats tableside in a rodízio format.
best_for: A long, meat-led group dinner with tableside rodízio service.
not_for: A quick, light meal or a vegetarian-led dinner.

name: CHASKAA GWK — Jimbaran
where: Jl. Raya Uluwatu, beside Indomaret, Jimbaran, Kuta Selatan, Badung, Bali, Indonesia
why_its_here: CHASKAA GWK is a modern Indian restaurant near Jimbaran serving curries, tandoor dishes and Indian street food.
best_for: Families and groups choosing modern Indian food near Jimbaran and GWK.

name: Chaskaa Modern Indian Cuisine and Bar at Jimbaran
where: Uluwatu St, Jimbaran, South Kuta, Badung Regency, Bali 80361
why_its_here: Restaurant on Uluwatu St in Uluwatu Bukit, open daily 11:00am-11:30pm.

name: Chaskaa Modern Indian Cuisine and Bar at Ubud
where: Jl. Suweta No.5, Ubud, Kecamatan Ubud, Kabupaten Gianyar, Bali 80571
why_its_here: CHASKAA Ubud is a modern Indian restaurant on Jalan Suweta serving curries, tandoor dishes and Indian street food.
best_for: Families and groups choosing modern Indian food in central Ubud.

name: Chill Reflexology
why_its_here: Reflexology studio in Seminyak. Booking is on the venue's own site.
best_for: A long reset — treatments run up to 120 minutes.

name: Chupacabras
where: Kedewatan, Ubud, Gianyar Regency, Bali
why_its_here: South American steakhouse in Kedewatan, Ubud. Prime cuts cook slowly over a two-metre wood-fire grill. Executive chef Mauro Santarelli, born in Argentina, works South American grilling with Indonesian spice. Natural stone rooms with open fire.
best_for: A grill dinner in Ubud
not_for: Lunch - it opens at 17:00

name: CHUPACABRAS - South American | Prime Meats
where: Kedewatan, Ubud, Gianyar Regency, Bali 80571
why_its_here: Chupacabras is a South American steakhouse in Kedewatan, Ubud. Meat is cooked on a two-metre Argentinian wood-fire grill. The current menu also covers ceviches, pasta and seafood.
best_for: A dinner built around South American wood-fire cooking.
not_for: A quick low-budget stop between activities.

name: Cinta Grill
where: Cinta Inn Jalan Monkey Forest, Ubud, Bali 80571
why_its_here: Restaurant in Cinta Inn Jalan Monkey Forest, Ubud.

name: Citrus Restaurant Ubud
where: Pejeng Kawan, Tampaksiring, Gianyar Regency, Bali 80552
why_its_here: Restaurant in Pejeng Kawan, Ubud, open daily 7:00am-11:00pm.

name: Cocomo at Canggu
where: Jl. Pantai Batu Bolong No.99, Canggu, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80351
why_its_here: An island bistro on Jl. Pantai Batu Bolong, a short way back from the shoreline, serving seafood and grill. Its Chope listing describes a recent repositioning into a seafood-led coastal bistro. Open daily 11:00-23:00, split into a lunch sitting until 5pm and dinner from 5pm.
best_for: Seafood and grill plates a short way back from Batu Bolong beach; lunch or dinner

name: Collina Kawi Restaurant at Kawi Resort
where: Tampaksiring, Gianyar Regency, Bali 80552
why_its_here: Restaurant in Tampaksiring, Ubud, open daily 9:00am-9:00pm.

name: Conrad Bali Yoga
why_its_here: Daily yoga at Conrad Bali in Tanjung Benoa, taught by the resort's instructors. Aerial yoga and sound healing are part of the wider wellness schedule. Classes carry an extra charge on top of the room rate.
best_for: Resort guests who want a daily class and are willing to pay separately for it, including aerial yoga and sound sessions.

name: Crumb & Coaster
why_its_here: A long-standing Kuta breakfast spot mixing Indonesian dishes with pasta and Thai curry, alongside a wide hot-and-cold coffee list.
best_for: an all-day breakfast stop in Kuta

name: D'Made Restaurant (The Kalyana Ubud Resort)
where: The Kalyana Ubud Resort, Jalan Cempaka No. 1, Ubud, Bali 80571
why_its_here: D'Made is The Kalyana Ubud Resort's 26-seat restaurant in Mas. It serves Indonesian and Balinese food beside the resort pool and surrounding greenery. Daily service runs from 07:00 to 23:00.
best_for: A small-table Indonesian or Balinese meal beside the resort pool.
not_for: Large groups that need a high-capacity dining room.

name: D’Pondok Warung (Pondok Sebatu Villa)
where: Pondok Sebatu Villa, Uma kaja, desa, Sebatu, Tegallalang, Ubud, Bali 80561
why_its_here: Restaurant in Pondok Sebatu Villa, Ubud.

name: De Daara Eateries (Anandadara Ubud)
where: Anandadara Ubud, Tirta Tawar, Banjar Abangan, Ubud, Bali 80571
why_its_here: Cafe in Anandadara Ubud, Ubud.

name: Tourism Village Besakih
why_its_here: Bali's largest and holiest temple complex, on the slopes of Mount Agung in Rendang, Karangasem. A single foreigner ticket bundles a local guide, sarong and shuttle up to the gate.
best_for: a guided visit to Bali's holiest temple complex; travellers comfortable with a managed, ticketed route

name: Tourism Village Bugbug
why_its_here: One of Karangasem's largest and oldest traditional (desa adat) villages, on the coast near Candidasa, with ceremonial traditions held through the year. The nearby Bukit Asah hilltop looks out over Pulau Kuan, a small whale-shaped island just offshore.
best_for: traditional Balinese village culture and ceremony; combining with Virgin Beach or Bukit Asah nearby

name: Tourism Village Gitgit
why_its_here: The village at the base of the well-known Gitgit waterfall, on the mountain road between south Bali and Singaraja, Buleleng.
best_for: a waterfall stop on the drive to/from north Bali

name: Tourism Village Sanur Kauh
why_its_here: A village in South Denpasar on Mertasari beach -- white sand and calm water facing north, so it catches both sunrise and sunset. Pura Dalam Pengembak Mertasari, on the beach, is used for melukat purification bathing.
best_for: a quieter beach than central Sanur; the Mertasari melukat temple; a flat rice-field jogging route

name: Dodo Pizza
where: Jl. Anggrek, Tibubeneng, Canggu, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361, Indonesia
why_its_here: Pizzeria on Jl. Anggrek, part of the Dodo chain. Dine-in and delivery. The delivery promise is 30 minutes, with a free-pizza code if it runs late.
best_for: A pizza delivered to the villa
not_for: An independent kitchen - this is an international chain

name: Dua Umalas
why_its_here: Restaurant in Seminyak. The kitchen is described as local and western. The published menu includes Pumpkin Ginger Soup, Green Juice and Wet Scrambled Eggs. Booking is by WhatsApp.
best_for: Local and western in Seminyak.

name: Empower Balance
why_its_here: Wellness spa in Tabanan. The published list covers Yoga.
best_for: Yoga booked the same day.

name: ESKQ Bar Steak House
where: Canggu, Kuta Utara, Badung Regency, Bali 80351
why_its_here: A steakhouse and wine bar on Jl. Raya Babakan, describing itself as serving premium steaks against a list of 50+ wines. Wood-fired cuts run from Australian grain-fed skirt and picanha up to a pre-order Tomahawk, alongside Italian pasta and risotto. The kitchen runs 6pm to 2am, Tuesday to Sunday, with a live jazz night programmed on Fridays.
best_for: Late steak and wine dinners, kitchen open to 2am; Friday live jazz
not_for: Dinner only from 6pm; closed Mondays

name: Flourish
where: 1 Nyuh Kuning Rd, Ubud, Bali 80571
why_its_here: A central healthy restaurant with explicit gluten-free and vegan positioning.
best_for: Early breakfast and gluten-free dining in Ubud.
not_for: People seeking cocktails or a luxury tasting menu.

name: Focaccia Buddies
where: Jl. Pantai Pererenan No.107, Pererenan, Kec. Mengwi, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80351, Indonesia
why_its_here: Focaccia sandwiches in Pererenan, run by two friends. Toppings include mortadella and stracciatella, and you can build your own. Coffee and matcha alongside.
best_for: A sandwich and coffee between surfs

name: French Kiss Restaurant
where: Monkey Forest, Street Jalan Wenara Wana, Ubud, Kecamatan Ubud, Kabupaten Gianyar, Bali 80571
why_its_here: Restaurant in Monkey Forest, Ubud, open daily 7:00am-10:30pm.

name: Fresh! Spa
why_its_here: Day spa in Ubud. The published list covers Foot Massage.
best_for: Tired feet after a day of walking.

name: Galangal Spa
why_its_here: Spa in Nusa Dua. The published list covers Traditional Massage. Booking is by WhatsApp.
best_for: Traditional massage booked the same day.

name: Gather
why_its_here: Restaurant in Canggu. The kitchen is described as breakfast and brunch. The published menu includes The Classic Brekkie, The Avo Set and The Gather Plate. Booking is by WhatsApp.
best_for: Breakfast and brunch in Canggu.

name: GIOI Ocean Gourmet
where: Discovery Mall Bali, Ground Floor Beach Front, Kuta, Kec. Kuta, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361

why_its_here: Restaurant in COMO Shambhala Estate, Ubud, open daily 11:00am-11:00pm.

name: Glow Spa Mandira
why_its_here: Day spa in Legian. The published list covers Balinese Massage and Traditional Massage. Traditional Balinese Aromatherapy Massage is 100K IDR for 60 minutes.
best_for: Balinese massage booked the same day.

name: Grand Hyatt Bali Fitness Centre
why_its_here: The Bay Club Fitness Center at Grand Hyatt Bali, set beneath the main lobby in Nusa Dua. It holds cardio equipment and machine weights, squash courts, a yoga studio, an adults-only pool, sauna, steam room and plunge pools. Class options include kickboxing alongside yoga.
best_for: Nusa Dua guests who want squash courts and an adults-only pool attached to the gym, not just machines.

name: Grillos Cafe & Eatery
where: Jl. Veteran No.99A, Buduk, Kec. Mengwi, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80351
why_its_here: A cafe and coffee shop on Jl. Veteran at Buduk, inland from Canggu in Mengwi, open 07:00-23:00 daily. Its own Grab listing describes the kitchen as Western cooking with Eastern flavours alongside a coffee shop. No readable menu is published online, so no dishes or prices are recorded here.
best_for: All-day cafe and coffee shop on Jl. Veteran at Buduk, open 7am to 11pm
not_for: Out at Buduk in Mengwi, not walkable from the Canggu beach strip

name: Ground Zero Kitchen
where: Jln Legian No.56x, Kuta, Badung Regency, Bali 80361
why_its_here: Restaurant in Kuta Legian, open daily 9:00am-3:30am.

name: Habitat Bistro
where: Jl. Bisma No.888A, Ubud, Kecamatan Ubud, Kabupaten Gianyar, Bali 80571, Indonesia
why_its_here: Bistro on Jl. Bisma with a jungle view, a pool and hammock beds. French and Italian cooking: handmade pasta, wood-fired pizza, antipasti. Lobster spaghetti with Calabrian chilli, ribeye with herb butter, roast salmon with cauliflower puree.
best_for: A long lunch by a pool in central Ubud

name: Hakkoku Bali - Sushi Omakase Restaurant
where: Inside The Sayan House Restaurant, Jl. Raya Sayan No.70, Sayan, Kecamatan Ubud, Kabupaten Gianyar, Bali 80571
why_its_here: Hakkoku Bali serves a 15-course sushi omakase at The Sayan House in Sayan. Lunch runs from 13:00 to 15:00, and dinner starts at 18:30. The Bali branch combines Japanese sushi technique with local Indonesian influences.
best_for: A planned fixed-course sushi lunch or dinner in Sayan.
not_for: Diners looking for an à-la-carte menu or an open-ended arrival time.

name: Hawa Gym Tukad Yeh Aya
why_its_here: A women-only gym at Jl. Tukad Yeh Aya No.85 in Renon, Denpasar, open Monday to Saturday 07:00-20:00 and closed on Sundays. It runs personal training and a class programme, with several membership payment options.
best_for: Women who want a female-only training space in Denpasar rather than a mixed tourist gym.

name: HENRY'S Steakhouse
where: Kuta, Badung Regency, Bali 80361
why_its_here: Restaurant in Kuta Legian, open daily 11:00am-11:00pm.

name: Herb Library Bali
where: F7R8+2P9, Jl. Jembawan, Ubud, Kecamatan Ubud, Kabupaten Gianyar, Bali 80571
why_its_here: A contemporary all-day venue with plant-based dishes and responsibly sourced fish and chicken options.
best_for: Mixed-diet groups wanting healthy all-day dining.
not_for: People looking specifically for a traditional Balinese warung.

name: Hidden Gem Uluwatu
why_its_here: Restaurant in the Bukit. The kitchen is described as California-inspired cuisine. The published menu includes Warm Chocolate Lava Cake, Three colored crispy soft shell tacos and Tuna Tartare. Booking runs through Chope.
best_for: California-inspired cuisine in the Bukit.

name: Hippie Fish Pererenan Beach
where: Pererenan / Mengwi / Pererenan Beach
why_its_here: A Mediterranean-inspired restaurant, rooftop and bar on Pererenan Beach, with a seafood-led kitchen. The second-floor dining room is air-conditioned and overlooks the beach, and the rooftop bar above it faces the sunset.
best_for: Beachfront sunset dinner and drinks; date night with a view; groups sharing seafood
not_for: Opens midday; the venue says booking is essential

name: Homaya Restaurant (Merusaka Nusa Dua)
where: Merusaka Nusa Dua, Kawasan Wisata Nusa Dua Lot S-3, Nusa Dua, Bali 80363
why_its_here: Restaurant in Merusaka Nusa Dua, Nusa Dua.

name: HOME Cafe MENGWI
where: Br. Tiying Tutul No.19, Pererenan, Mengwi, Badung Regency, Bali 80351, Indonesia
why_its_here: Cafe in Tiying Tutul, Pererenan. The kitchen describes its own cooking as healthy brunch.
best_for: Brunch away from the Batu Bolong strip

name: Honey Kitchen
where: Badung / Pererenan
why_its_here: An all-day cafe and restaurant at Jl. Pantai Pererenan No.132, open 7am to 10pm daily. Its listings describe Mediterranean and vegetarian-friendly cooking with separate brunch and dinner menus, plus outdoor seating, wifi and parking.
best_for: A long Mediterranean brunch on the Pererenan beach road, or a 7am breakfast.

name: House of Orange Beauty Canggu
where: Canggu
why_its_here: A nail salon at Jl. Pantai Berawa No.5 in Canggu, open daily 10:00-18:00. Its own site states it works on natural nails only, with no extensions or electric files, and it takes WhatsApp bookings as well as walk-ins.
best_for: Natural-nail manicures and pedicures in Berawa, walk-ins welcome.
not_for: No extensions or electric files; natural nails only.

name: House of Tundra
where: M5VG+GWM, Baturiti, Tabanan Regency, Bali 82191
why_its_here: Restaurant in M5VG+GWM, Tabanan, open daily 8:00am-8:00pm.

name: Hungry Bird Coffee Roaster
where: Jl. Segara Perancak No.86, Tibubeneng, Kuta Utara, Badung Regency, Bali 80361, Indonesia
why_its_here: A coffee roaster and daytime cafe on Jl. Segara Perancak in Tibubeneng, open 8am to 5pm daily. It roasts its own beans, sells single-origin bags through its own online store, and takes coffee-class enquiries.
best_for: Morning coffee from a working roastery, plus beans to take home.
not_for: Closes 5pm daily - no dinner service.

name: IKAN Restaurant and Bar at The Westin Resort Nusa Dua, Bali
where: The Westin Resort Nusa Dua Kawasan Pariwisata Nusa Dua, ITDC Lot No.N-3, Benoa, Kec. Kuta Sel., Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80363
why_its_here: Restaurant in The Westin Resort Nusa Dua Kawasan Pariwisata Nusa Dua, Nusa Dua, open daily 12:00-10:00pm.

name: IMBU Restaurant (The Kemilau Ubud)
where: The Kemilau Ubud Jalan Raya Pengosekan, Ubud, Bali 80571
why_its_here: IMBU is an open-layout restaurant at The Kemilau Ubud on Jalan Raya Pengosekan. Its menu pairs dishes such as tuna yukhoe and cured salmon with slow-cooked beef and regional Indonesian flavours. The dining room accommodates up to 100 guests.
best_for: Modern Asian plates in an open-layout Ubud resort restaurant.
not_for: A low-cost local-warung meal or a small, secluded dining room.

name: Inklusiv Warung
where: Jl. Munduk Catu No.8A, Canggu, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361
why_its_here: A warung at Jl. Munduk Catu No.8A whose own listings describe a mission to empower the Deaf and other minorities through employment. It serves Indonesian and European food from early morning until late and runs drag shows on Wednesday, Friday and Sunday nights.
best_for: Drag nights and late food at a Deaf-staffed, all-welcome Canggu warung.
not_for: Drag-show nights Wed, Fri and Sun from 8pm, 150K per person.

name: InterContinental Bali Resort Fitness Centre
why_its_here: The 24-hour fitness centre at InterContinental Bali Resort in Jimbaran, described by guests as large and well stocked with machines. A jogging track runs through the grounds, and the resort has tennis courts and six pools. Personal training is available, and Pencak Silat martial-arts sessions are on the activity list.
best_for: Jimbaran guests who want a big 24-hour gym plus a jogging track and tennis without leaving the resort.

name: InterContinental Bali Resort Yoga
why_its_here: Yoga at InterContinental Bali Resort in Jimbaran, offered through the 24-hour fitness centre and outdoors as seaside practice, with morning and sunset groups. A yoga instructor is available to guests.
best_for: Guests who want a sunrise or sunset session by the water rather than an indoor studio slot.

name: InterContinental Bali Sanur Resort Fitness Centre
why_its_here: The 24-hour fitness centre at InterContinental Bali Sanur Resort, on the ground floor next to the spa. It carries a treadmill and a spread of free weights suited to lifting and cross-fit style work, with a separate area for yoga and stretching. The resort has three outdoor pools and a steam room, and runs fitness classes.
best_for: South Sanur guests who want free weights rather than a machine-only hotel gym.

name: Intuitive Flow
where: Nalanda School, Penestanan Kelod, Ubud, Gianyar 80571
why_its_here: A long-established Penestanan studio with a glass-walled, open-air shala perched above the rice fields, reached by the hillside footpath near Alchemy.
best_for: Practitioners who want daily drop-in classes across many styles in one of Ubud's most scenic garden settings; good for beginners.
not_for: Anyone unable to manage the short uphill walk from the road.

name: Ja'Jan Bistro at Merusaka Nusa Dua
where: Kawasan Wisata Nusa Dua, Lot S-3, Benoa, Nusa Dua, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80363
why_its_here: Restaurant in Kawasan Wisata Nusa Dua, Nusa Dua, open daily 11:00am-11:00pm.

name: Jack Fruit Restaurant at Pramana Giri Kusuma
where: H6MW+VJ, Melinggih, Payangan, Gianyar Regency, Bali 80572
why_its_here: Restaurant in H6MW+VJ, Ubud, open daily 8:00am-11:00pm.

name: Jade by Todd English
where: Jl. Pemelisan Agung, Tibubeneng, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361
why_its_here: Jade by Todd English is a Mediterranean restaurant and bar in Berawa built around an open wood-fire grill, with a menu designed for sharing. Dinner only, Tuesday to Sunday, running late into a bar service at the end of the week.
best_for: Wood-fire Mediterranean sharing plates, dinner only, in a small Berawa room.
not_for: Lunch or brunch — service starts at 5pm and it's closed Mondays.

name: Jalapeno
where: Jl. Raya Semat Gg. Anggur No.1, Tibubeneng, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361
why_its_here: The Canggu branch of Jalapeno, at Jl. Raya Semat Gg. Anggur No.1 in Tibubeneng. Its own site describes the brand as modern Tex-Mex serving since 2014, with two venues, in Sanur and in Canggu.
best_for: A Tex-Mex dinner and margaritas in Canggu that runs late into the evening.

name: Jatiluwih
why_its_here: UNESCO-listed rice terraces at roughly 700 metres altitude in Tabanan, among the largest and most intact subak (traditional irrigation) landscapes on the island.
best_for: walking or cycling through UNESCO-listed rice terraces; a quieter alternative to Tegallalang

name: Jimbaran Hub Fitness / Classes
where: Jimbaran
why_its_here: A community sports hub in Jimbaran running fitness and martial-arts classes, including karate, for adults and kids.
best_for: Families and locals who want structured classes rather than a tourist gym.

name: Jimbaran Hub Yoga
where: Jimbaran
why_its_here: The yoga classes at Jimbaran Hub, a community sports-and-wellness centre with a broad weekly timetable (Mon–Sat 8am–10pm).
best_for: Locals and long-stayers who want regular, affordable classes in Jimbaran.

name: Jungle Flower Restaurant
where: C7H7+QX3, Lodtunduh, Kecamatan Ubud, Kabupaten Gianyar, Bali 80582, Indonesia
why_its_here: Restaurant inside Jungle Flower Villas in Lodtunduh, open since 2024. Jungle setting south of central Ubud.
best_for: A meal outside central Ubud

name: Kafe
why_its_here: Restaurant in Ubud. The kitchen is described as varied international. The published menu includes Meg's Big Salad Bowl, Meg's Mini Bowl and Kale Detox Salad. Booking is on the venue's own site.
best_for: Varied international in Ubud.

name: Karma Jimbaran Fitness
where: Jimbaran Bay / villa resort
why_its_here: The gym at Karma Jimbaran, a beachside villa resort near Jimbaran Bay, open 7am–9pm for guests and day visitors.
best_for: Villa-resort guests who want a straightforward workout with a view.

name: Karsa Cafe
where: Ubud
why_its_here: A rice-paddy and jungle-valley hideaway café along the Campuhan Ridge Walk, serving organic meals, seasonal fruit smoothies, and gourmet coffee with unobstructed green views.
best_for: Travelers finishing the Campuhan Ridge Walk who want a calm, scenic break with healthy food; quiet daytime pause surrounded by rice fields.
not_for: Large groups or late-night plans — it's a small daytime venue (8am-6pm) reached by a walk down into the valley.

name: Kaum Bali
where: Desa Potato Head, Beach Club Ground Level, Jl. Petitenget No.51B, Seminyak, Kuta Utara, Badung, Bali 80361, Indonesia
why_its_here: Kaum Bali is a regional Indonesian restaurant on the ground level of Desa Potato Head in Petitenget.
best_for: Groups wanting to explore regional Indonesian dishes in Seminyak.

name: Kedisan Kintamani
where: Oculus Bali Jalan Windu Sara, Kedisan, Kintamani, Bali 80652
why_its_here: Cafe in Oculus Bali Jalan Windu Sara, Bangli.

name: Kekeb Restaurant
why_its_here: Restaurant in Nusa Dua. The kitchen is described as Indonesian, Balinese, Seafood. The published menu includes Rendang package, Chicken Betutu and Sate. Booking is by WhatsApp.
best_for: Indonesian, Balinese, Seafood in Nusa Dua.

name: KŌWHAI Restaurant at MĀUA Nusa Penida
where: Sakti, Nusa Penida, Klungkung Regency, Bali 80771
why_its_here: Restaurant in Sakti, Nusa Islands, open daily 7:00am-10:00pm.

name: KU DE TA
where: Jl. Kayu Aya No.9, Seminyak, Kec. Kuta, Kabupaten Badung, Bali
why_its_here: Bali's original beachfront club, on the sand at Seminyak Beach, running from morning through sunset into late night with dining, a bar, pool and daybeds. An all-day beach-club-plus-restaurant rather than a quick stop.
best_for: sunset drinks on the beach; a long lunch-into-evening on a daybed; a special occasion by the ocean
not_for: budget travellers (daybeds/sofas carry a minimum spend); anyone wanting a small, quiet intimate dinner

name: Kupu Kupu Day Spa
why_its_here: A day spa overlooking Kuta Beach doing manicures, pedicures and hair treatments with OPI products, plus a blow-dry bar.
best_for: a beachfront mani-pedi and blow-dry near Kuta Beach

name: Kush Day Spa
why_its_here: Day spa in Ubud. The published list covers Ayurvedic Treatment. Booking is on the venue's own site.
best_for: Ayurvedic treatment booked the same day.

name: La Joya
why_its_here: Resort spa in the Bukit. The published list covers Couple Massage. Booking is on the venue's own site.
best_for: Couples — the list includes a couple treatment.
